title: Applied AI Specialist – Python & React
description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for an **Applied AI Specialist – Python & React** with strong experience in Python programming, React development, and web service integration to develop, test, and maintain high-quality software applications.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
1. Develop, test, and maintain high-quality software applications using Python.  
2. Build and maintain user interfaces using React.js, with strong hands-on frontend development experience.  
3. Develop and integrate web services and APIs using REST/SOAP architecture.  
4. Work with Python frameworks such as Flask, Django, or FastAPI.  
5. Implement asynchronous processing and integrate frontend and backend services.  
6. Work with SQL and NoSQL databases for data storage, retrieval, and management.  
7. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.  
8. Contribute to machine learning model development and integration, preferably with hands-on ML experience.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong Python programming skills.
* Hands-on experience with React.js.
* Experience in Flask, Django, or FastAPI.
* Knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs and web service integration.
* Understanding of asynchronous programming.
* Hands-on experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Experience with CI/CD tools and processes.
* Machine Learning experience is an added advantage.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: IT Engineer,Software,Intermediate
description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities:

We are looking for a IT Engineer, Software (Intermediate) with 3–5 years of hands-on experience building and supporting business-critical web applications. The ideal candidate combines strong front-end development skills with a solid design sensibility, and brings proven expertise in **Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)** to help build and maintain scalable, component-driven applications on the enterprise content platform.

This role sits at the intersection of design and engineering within the IT Business Applications function — translating wireframes and design systems into responsive, accessible, production-ready interfaces within an AEM-based platform.

* Design and develop responsive, user-centric web interfaces from wireframes, prototypes, and design specifications.
* Build, customize, and maintain AEM components, templates, and client libraries (HTL/Sightly, JS, CSS).
* Collaborate closely with UX designers, product managers, and back-end developers to translate design concepts into functional AEM pages and components.

* Ensure UI consistency by contributing to and maintaining a shared design system / component library.
* Optimize front-end performance, page load times, and cross-browser/cross-device compatibility.
* Conduct usability reviews and incorporate feedback from user testing into design and development iterations.
* Ensure all interfaces meet accessibility standards (WCAG/ADA compliance).
* Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies.
* Troubleshoot and resolve UI-related defects across the AEM platform.
* Stay current with UI/UX trends, front-end frameworks, and AEM platform updates.

Qualifications:

B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA in Computers, IT or other related streams with 3-5 years of working experience with following skills:

  

* 3 - 5 years of experience in UI/UX development, front-end engineering, or a related role.
* Hands-on experience with **Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)** — component development, templates, HTL/Sightly, Sling models, and client libraries.
* Strong proficiency in **HTML5, CSS3/SASS/LESS, JavaScript (ES6+)**.
* Experience with modern front-end frameworks/libraries (e.g., React, Vue, or similar) integrated with AEM.
* Solid understanding of **responsive and adaptive design** principles.
* Proficiency with design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch).
* Strong grasp of UX principles — usability, information architecture, and interaction design.
* Experience working with design systems and component libraries.
* Familiarity with version control (Git) and Agile/Scrum development practices.
* Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / ADA).
* Strong attention to detail and ability to bridge design intent with technical implementation.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design/technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, Agile teams.
* Problem-solving orientation with a keen eye for detail and design consistency.

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

* AEM certification (Adobe Certified Expert – AEM Developer).
* Experience with AEM as a Cloud Service.
* Familiarity with headless AEM / GraphQL implementations.
* Exposure to A/B testing and analytics tools (Adobe Target, Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics).
* Experience with cross-functional collaboration in large-scale enterprise environments.
* Basic knowledge of Java/backend concepts relevant to AEM development.

Careers Privacy Statement\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\*

title: Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer, Product and Front-end

**About this role**

* The Senior Software Engineer, Product and Front-end will help build Prudential Japan's next generation Product Engineering capabilities as part of the Japan Technology Transformation initiative.
* This role is responsible for designing, building, and operating digital products and platforms that support customer journeys, sales journeys, policy administration experiences, and business workflows across Prudential Japan's end-to-end journey of life insurance value streams.
* As part of a newly established Product Engineering organization, this role offers the opportunity not only to build products, but also to help establish engineering practices, standards, and ways of working that will shape the future of technology delivery at Prudential Japan. What you could work on We allocate after offer, across multiple domains. Customer servicing, portals used by our employees as well as customers to view policy information and execute certain business workflows. Sales Enablement, portal used by our sales team to manage leads and maintain regulatory records.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build customer-facing journeys, and the internal tools staff use when a customer cannot complete one alone.
* Model identity, consent and authority as first-class concepts, including the cases where one person acts on anotherʼs behalf.
* Work directly with the staff who handle these requests today, watching real cases rather than reading summarised tickets.
* Design for users of every age and confidence level, treating accessibility as a design constraint rather than an audit term.
* Instrument journeys so drop-off, error and abandonment are visible, then act on what they show.
* Share the APIs your journeys need together with their backend owners, rather than accepting whatever exists.
* Work closely with systems engineers, architects and business partners to ensure the quality and reliability of the product, and to deliver on business objectives.
* Work alongside long-lived legacy systems and decide, case by case, what to wrap, what to replace and what to leave alone.
* Engage with broader product considerations and planning across ideation, design, development, testing, business engagement and team leadership.
* Carry on-call for what you own, and run incident reviews that look for causes rather than for someone to blame.

**Qualifications**

**General**

* You do not need insurance experience. We will teach the domain.
* Five or more years in product engineering with genuine front-end depth, TypeScript and a modern framework.
* Demonstrated accessibility practice, with examples of what you changed and why.
* Experience in designing workflow and state and not only screens.
* User research or direct observation as a normal part of how you work.
* Advantageous: contact center or telephone integration, identity, consent or KYC workflows, and designing for older or less confident users.
* Degree in relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical**

* We run on AWS. We are not dogmatic about languages or frameworks and we do not screen on keyword matches: we care that you have gone deep in at least one stack and can pick up another. Depth in one column beats a shallow tick in all of them.
* AI assisted development: Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor. Knowing how to build Agent skills is an advantage.
* Frontend: TypeScript with React, and a framework such as Next.js. Strong CSS and layout skills
* Testing: component and end-to-end testing as a habit. Playwright, Vitest or Jest and accessibility checks in the pipeline.
* Design systems: consuming one, contributing to one, and knowing when to break it.
* Backend for frontend: API gateway with lambda or a small service, enough to own the layer your journeys depend on.
* AWS ecosystem
* Nice to have: analytics and session instrumentation (such as Amplitude), design tooling fluency (such as Figma), and telephony and contact centre integration such as Genesys telephony or Amazon Connect.

**Language**

English: Fluent to Native

Japanese: Working level. JLPT N2 or native is an advantage.

**Culture and Leadership Expectations**

* Act as One Prudential for customers by building integrated products across business domains Drive Change by modernizing legacy systems and improving engineering practices
* Be Highly Accountable for code quality, delivery, reliability, and production outcomes
* Engage with Candor through open collaboration and constructive technical discussion Demonstrate core values: Worthy of Trust, Customer Focused, Respect for Each Other, and Winning with Integrity

**Skills:** Product Engineering , TypeScript , AWS
